text:
Lia (Marketing): Quick thread — micro roundtable next Tue 11am PT. Need owners for reg page, Zoom recording, captions, and HubSpot routing. Can we confirm owners?

Sophia: I can take reg page + CTA A/B test. Will push copy variants today. Short link?

Ben: Happy to own HubSpot mapping and lead routing. Need campaign UTM & form field list. Send specs.

Mike Ops: I'll handle Zoom config and RTMP fallback. For recording, prefer local + cloud S3 upload. RTMP target: s3-uploader-prod. Need auth.

Carla: I'll own captions/transcripts. For on-demand asset, we should produce SRT + speaker labels. Add transcript QA pass.

Lia (Marketing): Thanks — @Sophia please add two CTA variants: "Try Redwood" vs "Request Demo". Keep reg form to email + company + use-case.

Sophia: Added draft copy to Notion: https://redwoodHQ.notion.site/micro-roundtable-draft — comments welcome.

Ben: For HubSpot, map form fields: email, company, use_case, plan_interest. Also tag source=microroundtable, utm_campaign=mar-q2.

Mike Ops: Zoom settings I'm planning:
```
recording: cloud + local
auto_recording: host
audio_only: false
rtmp_fallback: true
postproc: upload to s3://redwood-event-archive/micro-roundtable/
```
Need Zoom host key and RTMP creds.

ZoomBot: Recording started 2026-03-25T11:02:12Z -> Record ID abc123

Carla: On captions — prefer Rev for first-pass, then internal edit. Who will own vendor spend?

Lia (Marketing): I'll cover Rev for < $200, we can expense. @Ben make sure lead owner tagging added in HubSpot.

Sophia: Quick note on replay page: include 2 short CTAs and timestamped chapters. I'll design.

Ben: Once recording is in S3, I'll trigger Zapier flow to HubSpot and mark lead as "engaged-webinar".

Mike Ops: After event, I'll run small job to split file into clips and push to clip pipeline. Need clip owners for social.

Lia (Marketing): Assign social clips to Asha and Tom. Also set SLA: first clip within 48 hours, full transcript within 72 hours.

Carla: Ack. I'll deliver SRT + speaker labels in 72h.

Sophia: CTA A variant looks better in quick test. We'll iterate copy up to 3 times before launch.

Ben: I'll set up lead scoring rule: event_engagement >= 1 => MQL nurture sequence.

Mike Ops: One more — add fallback mode for low bandwidth: disable video and record audio-only chunks.

Lia (Marketing): Perfect. Thanks team. If no blockers, I'll lock the reg page at 9am PT tomorrow. :rocket:
